description: A gray plastic tub with several clear ice cubes sits on the bed next to a small yellow cup, and a purple scoop rests to the right. The right hand picks up the purple scoop and dips it into the tub to gather ice while the left hand steadies the tub, then the left hand lifts and tilts the yellow cup under the scoop as the right hand tips the scoop to dump the ice into the cup before setting the scoop back down.
